q: 1. The scale used for drawing working details of element is .............
explain: Detailed working drawings of individual structural/building elements are typically drawn at a larger scale such as 1:25, providing sufficient clarity for construction-level detail.

q: 2. Conceptual layout plan developed for preliminary discussion is .............
explain: A line plan is a preliminary, simplified layout drawing (showing basic room arrangement as lines) prepared for initial concept discussion before detailed design work begins.

q: 3. For drawing the components of a wrist watch, the scale used is .............
explain: Since wrist watch components are extremely small, they must be drawn at an enlarged scale to show sufficient detail for manufacturing and inspection.

q: 4. The R.F. of scale is always .............
explain: The Representative Fraction can be less than 1 (reducing scale), equal to 1 (full-size scale), or greater than 1 (enlarging scale), depending on the relationship between drawing size and actual size, so it can take any of these values.
Since R.F. is a ratio of two lengths in the same units, the units cancel out entirely, making R.F. a dimensionless (unitless) quantity — hence 'none of these.'

q: 6. The full form of R.F. is .............
explain: R.F. stands for Representative Fraction, the standard term for the ratio between drawing length and actual object length.

q: 7. A map of 10 cm × 8 cm represents an area of 50000 sq. metre of a field. The R.F. of the scale is .............
explain: Map area = 10×8=80 cm²; actual area=50000 m²=500,000,000 cm². Area ratio=80/500,000,000=1/6,250,000; taking the square root gives the linear R.F. = 1/2500.

q: 8. An area of 36 square kilometer is represented by 144 square centimeter on a map. What is the R.F.?
explain: Area ratio = 144 cm² / 36 km² = 144 cm² / 360,000,000,000 cm² ; taking the square root of this area ratio gives the linear R.F. = 1/50000.

q: 9. Drawings used in construction site are known as .............
explain: Working drawings, containing all dimensions and details needed for execution, are the drawings actually used and referenced at the construction site.

q: 10. The exact value of R.F. of an Isometric scale is .............
explain: Note: per the answer key, 9/11 is marked as the exact R.F. value here — an approximate fractional equivalent close to the mathematically derived isometric ratio (√(2/3) ≈ 0.8165).

q: 11. Scale of chord is used to measure .............
explain: A scale of chords is a specialized scale specifically constructed to measure and construct angles using chord lengths corresponding to given angular values.
